boundary_source: DC Health Planning Neighborhoods (Open Data DC)

neighborhoods.name: Friendship Heights
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC single-member districts 3E03 and 3E04, around the Friendship Heights Metro (Open Data DC). DC has no planning area for Friendship Heights; this overlaps the Tenleytown site.

neighborhoods.name: Georgetown
neighborhoods.boundary_source: Georgetown Historic District (DC Historic Preservation Office, Open Data DC). DC's GEORGETOWN planning area covers only the western half of the neighborhood.

neighborhoods.name: Chevy Chase
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC 3/4G, the Chevy Chase DC commission (all its single-member districts, Open Data DC). DC's CHEVY CHASE planning area stops at Connecticut Avenue; this overlaps the Tenleytown site a little.

neighborhoods.name: Cleveland Park
neighborhoods.boundary_source: Cleveland Park Historic District (DC Historic Preservation Office, Open Data DC). DC has no planning area named Cleveland Park.

neighborhoods.name: Dupont Circle
neighborhoods.boundary_source: Dupont Circle Historic District (DC Historic Preservation Office, Open Data DC). DC has no planning area named Dupont Circle; this overlaps the Adams Morgan site to the north.

neighborhoods.name: H Street NE
neighborhoods.boundary_source: The six ANC single-member districts along H Street NE from 3rd to 15th Street (6A01, 6A02, 6A06, 6C04, 6C05, 6C06; Open Data DC). DC has no planning area for H Street.

neighborhoods.name: Navy Yard
neighborhoods.boundary_source: Navy Yard (Capitol Riverfront) Business Improvement District boundary (Open Data DC). DC's planning area here is SW/Waterfront.

neighborhoods.name: Brookland
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC single-member districts 5B02-5B06 (the Brookland commission's core), 5F02 (Monroe Street Market, the Arts Walk, Dance Place) and 5A04 (Catholic University and the Basilica), Open Data DC. DC has no planning area named Brookland.

neighborhoods.name: Glover Park
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC 3B, the Glover Park commission (all its single-member districts, Open Data DC). DC has no planning area named Glover Park.

neighborhoods.name: L'Enfant Plaza
neighborhoods.boundary_source: Southwest Business Improvement District, which takes in L'Enfant Plaza and the federal blocks around it (Open Data DC). DC has no planning area for L'Enfant Plaza.

neighborhoods.name: NoMa
neighborhoods.boundary_source: NoMa Business Improvement District boundary (Open Data DC). DC has no planning area for NoMa.

neighborhoods.name: Palisades
neighborhoods.boundary_source: DC Health Planning Neighborhoods: Kent/Palisades (Open Data DC). It includes Kent and the C&O Canal parkland along the river.

neighborhoods.name: Logan Circle
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC 2F, the Logan Circle commission (all its single-member districts, Open Data DC). DC's LOGAN CIRCLE/SHAW planning area also covers Shaw, which has its own site.

neighborhoods.name: Shaw
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC 2G, the Shaw commission (all its single-member districts, Open Data DC). DC's LOGAN CIRCLE/SHAW planning area also covers Logan Circle, which has its own site.

neighborhoods.name: U Street
neighborhoods.boundary_source: DC Health Planning Neighborhoods: U Street/Pleasant Plains (Open Data DC), so it includes Howard University and Pleasant Plains.

neighborhoods.name: Van Ness
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC single-member districts 3F01, 3F02 and 3F05 around the Van Ness-UDC Metro (Open Data DC). DC has no planning area named Van Ness.

neighborhoods.name: Foggy Bottom
neighborhoods.boundary_source: DC Health Planning Neighborhoods: GWU, which covers Foggy Bottom and the West End (Open Data DC).

neighborhoods.name: Woodley Park
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC single-member districts 3C01, 3C02, 3C03 and 3C07, around the Woodley Park Metro and the National Zoo (Open Data DC). DC's WOODLEY PARK planning area also takes in much of Cleveland Park, which has its own site.

neighborhoods.name: Brightwood
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC single-member districts 4A04, 4A05, 4A06, 4A07, 4B05, 4D01, 4D02 and 4D03, along upper Georgia Avenue and Kennedy Street (Open Data DC). It takes in Brightwood and Brightwood Park; DC's BRIGHTWOOD planning area also holds central Takoma, which has its own site.

neighborhoods.name: Congress Heights
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC single-member districts 8C02, 8C03, 8C04, 8C06, 8C07, 8C08, 8E03, 8E04 and 8E05, around the Congress Heights Metro, St. Elizabeths East and THEARC (Open Data DC). DC's CONGRESS HEIGHTS/SHIPLEY planning area leaves out the Metro station and the arena.

neighborhoods.name: Takoma
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC single-member districts 4A01, 4A02, 4A03, 4B01, 4B02, 4B03 and 4B04, the DC side of Takoma plus Shepherd Park and the Parks at Walter Reed (Open Data DC). Takoma Park, Maryland, is not included. DC's planning areas split this ground: Takoma Metro falls in BRIGHTWOOD, not SHEPHERD PARK.

neighborhoods.name: Deanwood
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC 7C, single-member districts 7C01 through 7C09, the commission that holds Deanwood (Open Data DC). DC has no planning area named Deanwood; most of this ground is its LINCOLN HEIGHTS area.

neighborhoods.name: Hillcrest
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC single-member districts 7B02, 7B03, 7B05, 7B06, 8B02 and 8B05, about the same ground as DC's NAYLOR/HILLCREST planning area (Open Data DC). Hillcrest Heights, Maryland, is not included.

neighborhoods.name: Bellevue
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC single-member districts 8D01, 8D03, 8D05, 8D06, 8E07, 8E08 and 8E09, the homes in DC's BELLEVUE planning area (Open Data DC). 8D04 is left out: it is mostly the empty land at DC's southern tip.

neighborhoods.name: 16th Street Heights
neighborhoods.boundary_source: ANC 4E, single-member districts 4E01 through 4E06, including Crestwood west of 16th Street (Open Data DC). DC's 16TH ST HEIGHTS planning area also runs south into Petworth, which has its own site.
